items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1968-11-30
items.q: Isaiah Morgan's band. Young Sam Morgan. Yeah. And Jim used to give me lots of work.

ctx.x: to hear it like that. Some of the fellas, they, they want to be shown. And naturally, the fellas try to play, a man taking a solo, and he tell you to get out of there. Well, that's the best work I have to do. I'll quickly get out. They'll tell me who wants to get out. I'll get out. Especially nowadays. But before I didn't mind. But the band's played, you know, like that. If you're going to, well, you're going to stick out, other bands get on there. But everybody's playing, you know. On there, you see. Might have…
you ever hear Jim Robinson playing from when you were young? Yeah. Sure. I used to play with, uh,

Isaiah Morgan's band. Young Sam Morgan. Yeah. And Jim used to give me lots of work. He used to work on the riverfront, I think. Yeah. And his band would go out of town, especially in the wintertime when I'd just come in there off the show or something like that. Well, he'd work with his band. Isaiah Morgan. Not Sam. Isaiah. Yeah. And the fellow just died
